## Answers

**q05** — 8: AIService (proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto:11), AttachmentService (attachment_service.proto:15), AuthService (auth_service.proto:13), IdentityProviderService (idp_service.proto:14), InstanceService (instance_service.proto:17), MemoService (memo_service.proto:17), ShortcutService (shortcut_service.proto:14), UserService (user_service.proto:17)

- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70 (call at :115) — the only API-layer caller of `Store.CreateMemo`
- (indirect: `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56 reuses `s.CreateMemo`, not the store method directly)

**q12**

- backend handler — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:178
- store method — store/memo.go:116
- dialect impl — store/db/sqlite/memo.go:54 (also mysql/memo.go:62, postgres/memo.go:51)

**q13** (files referencing `store.Memo`, from blast radius)
- store/memo.go, store/driver.go
- store/db/sqlite/memo.go, store/db/mysql/memo.go, store/db/postgres/memo.go
- server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go, memo_service_converter.go, memo_update_helpers.go, memo_mention_helpers.go, memo_batch_helpers.go, memo_attachment_service.go, memo_relation_service.go, sse_event_helpers.go, common.go
- server/notification/email.go, server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go
- server/router/rss/rss.go, server/runner/memopayload/runner.go

**q14** — RPCs: ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, DeleteShortcut (proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto:18–48). Implemented in server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:49,95,135,211,284 (Connect adapters in connect_services.go)

**q15**
- user: `User` — store/user.go:29

**q16** — In `Store.DeleteMemo` (store/memo.go:140–158): (1) `memo_relation` rows where the memo is the source (`MemoID`), (2) `memo_relation` rows where it is the target (`RelatedMemoID`), (3) every linked attachment via `DeleteAttachment` (store/attachment.go:132, which also removes the blob/local file), then the memo row. The API handler additionally deletes comment memos first (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567–577).

**q17** — web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; uses `memoServiceClient` (MemoService client, web/src/connect.ts:197)

**q18** — store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go, store/db/mysql/mysql.go, store/db/postgres/postgres.go; factory `NewDBDriver` — store/db/db.go:14

**q19**
- gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON — server/router/api/v1/v1.go:96–128 (`RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` at :108; generated routes in proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go)
- ConnectRPC — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40 (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`), mounted at server/router/api/v1/v1.go:139–144 (`/memos.api.v1.*`); method wrappers in server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go

**q20** — Mechanism: Server-Sent Events (`GET /api/v1/sse`, server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:25; frontend consumer web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts:203). Hub: server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go (`SSEHub`, `Broadcast` at :115). Broadcasting handlers: `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (memo_service.go:163), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:585), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:20), `UpsertMemoReaction` (reaction_service.go:60), `DeleteMemoReaction` (reaction_service.go:111), and `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (memo_update_helpers.go:66) used by `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`.

**q21**
- `auth.Authenticator.AuthenticateByRefreshToken` — server/auth/authenticator.go:61
- `auth.Authenticator.resolveBearer` — server/auth/authenticator.go:149
- `notification.EmailDispatcher.DispatchInboxEmail` — server/notification/email.go:40

- `APIV1Service.getLinkedSSOUser` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:150
- `APIV1Service.resolveSSOUser` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:19
- `ResolveUserByName` — server/router/api/v1/user_resource_name.go:49
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
- `RSSService.GetUserRSS` — server/router/rss/rss.go:111
- `Store.GetUserByPATHash` — store/user_setting.go:128

**q22** — Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called from server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157; funnels into `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, :48). Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` enqueues, internal/webhook/webhook.go:184; `Post` performs the HTTP POST, :120, over an SSRF-guarded client :32). Signing: Standard-Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID.timestamp.body` with the per-hook `whsec_`-prefixed secret, sent as `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<sig>` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:133–149).

**q23**
- SQL schema: store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33 (mysql/LATEST.sql:32, postgres/LATEST.sql:32)
- Go store model: store/memo.go:35
- API proto message: proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198
- Generated frontend types: web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:79

**q24**
- web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178 (`useCreateMemo` mutation, call at :183)
- web/src/connect.ts:197 (`memoServiceClient`)
- proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21 (`rpc CreateMemo`)
- server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306 (Connect wrapper) → server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70 (handler; store call at :115)
- store/memo.go:109 (`Store.CreateMemo`)
- store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16 (`INSERT INTO memo` at :41)

**q25** — Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) filter engine in `internal/filter` — internal/filter/engine.go:14–71 (schema internal/filter/schema.go, SQL renderer internal/filter/render.go). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then `Render`/`AppendConditions` (internal/filter/engine.go:96, internal/filter/helpers.go:9) emits a dialect-specific WHERE fragment plus args — each driver passes its dialect (`filter.DialectSQLite` store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61, `DialectMySQL` store/db/mysql/memo.go:69, `DialectPostgres` store/db/postgres/memo.go:58) and appends the fragment to its query.

**q26** — `memo` (the row itself plus comment memos, memo_service.go:574,580 / store/memo.go:158), `memo_relation` (both directions, store/memo.go:142,145), `attachment` (store/memo.go:149–157 → store/attachment.go:132), and `memo_share` by declared FK `ON DELETE CASCADE` (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109, postgres:108, mysql:108) — note SQLite opens with `foreign_keys(0)` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53), so that cascade is not enforced there. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (memo_service.go:545) but not deleted.

**q27** — Mechanism: the Vite build output is compiled into the binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA `index.html` fallback — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20–21 (embed), :41–61 (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); wired at server/server.go:72 (`frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28**
- `s3presign.Runner` — one immediate `RunOnce` at startup, then a `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (server/server.go:162–171; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27–41)
- Unused-infra note: `internal/scheduler` (cron-expression scheduler, internal/scheduler/scheduler.go, doc.go) is **not** used by the server — its only importers are its own tests (internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10, integration_test.go:13). Also `server/runner/memopayload` is not a scheduled runner despite the path: `RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline from the memo handler (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447).

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in web/src/connect.ts:156 (installed on the transport at :188; token plumbing in web/src/auth-state.ts). Tokens it manages: short-lived JWT **access token** in localStorage (`memos_access_token`, auth-state.ts:6,78) sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` (connect.ts:99), plus a **refresh token** held in an HttpOnly cookie (`memos_refresh`, server/auth/token.go:49) used via `AuthService.RefreshToken` (connect.ts:72–83) with cross-tab BroadcastChannel sync; PATs (`memos_pat_…`) are also accepted on the same header server-side. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (server/auth/token.go `ParseAccessTokenV2`/`ParseRefreshToken`, server/auth/authenticator.go:41,61,102), invoked through `Authorizer` (server/router/api/v1/authz.go:44) for both gRPC-Gateway and Connect.

**q30**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
- Convergence: the first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48); all four then call `webhook.PostAsync` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:184) which delivers via `webhook.Post` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:120).
